title: Stability of Signed Dictators from Condorcet Probability
statement: Let $\iota$ be an index type with a filter $\ell$, and for each $t\in\iota$ let $n_t$ be a natural number, let $f_t$ be a Boolean function on the $n_t$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\varepsilon_t\in\mathbb{R}$. Suppose that the probability that $f_t$'s societal outcome has a Condorcet winner is $1-\varepsilon_t$ for every $t$, that $0\leq\varepsilon_t$ for every $t$, and that $\frac{9}{2}\varepsilon_t\leq\frac{1}{1600}$ for every $t$. Then there are, for each $t$, an input coordinate and a choice of whether to negate its dictator function, such that the resulting relative Hamming distances from $f_t$ are $O[\ell](\varepsilon_t)$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural-number arity $n_t$ for each index
A Boolean function $f_t$ of arity $n_t$ for each index
A real parameter $\varepsilon_t$ for each index
Condorcet-winner probability equals $1-\varepsilon_t$ for every index
